Anki Minerは、端末内の動画や読書素材から日本語の語彙を抽出し、AnkiDroid経由でAnkiのフラッシュカードを作成します。マイニングに必要なリソースを、この短いセットアップで順に確認します。
Every step is optional and everything here can be done later in Settings.
The UniDic tokenizer dictionary is required for mining. It is a one-time download stored privately on this device.
Ankiノートに保存する定義用のオフライン辞書を選択します。Jitendexを推奨します。JMdictはより軽量です。片方、両方、またはどちらもインストールしない設定を選べます。
Anki MinerはAnkiDroid経由でAnkiノートを作成します。必要ならAnkiDroidをインストールし、データベースへのアクセスを許可してください。
マイニングしたAnkiノートから生成される復習カードのデッキを選択します。検出済みのデッキ、または「Anki Minerを作成または使用」を選んでください。存在しないデッキは作成される場合がありますが、ノートタイプは作成されません。

Jitendex is shared under CC BY-SA 4.0. Its JMdict/JMnedict data is provided by the Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group under the EDRDG licence. Tatoeba examples are CC BY 2.0 FR, Kanji alive audio is CC BY 4.0, and JmdictFurigana is CC BY-SA 4.0. Follow the source URLs below for the complete terms and contributor records.

Jisho is disabled by default. If you enable it in Settings and the engine reaches the Jisho fallback, Japanese lookup terms derived from selected subtitles or reading content are sent to https://jisho.org. Video, audio, complete source files, complete sentences, Anki collection data, and account identifiers are not sent by this fallback.
Android enforces at least one second between Jisho requests. Disable Jisho to keep definition lookup fully offline.

Selected media, reading files, Anki collection data, installed resources, settings, and recovery journals are processed locally. This app includes no account, advertising, analytics, or remote crash-reporting SDK.

Pinned language resources are downloaded from their listed HTTPS hosts. Jisho is the only automatic content-derived lookup egress and remains off until you explicitly enable it. Remote dictionary images are blocked; unrelated dictionary links require an explicit tap. Offline Android TTS does not send sentence text to a network voice.
App-private data remains until replaced, app storage is cleared, or the app is uninstalled. Notes and media already added to AnkiDroid remain in AnkiDroid and must be managed there.
